sections.heading: 全局症状疗效：证据与分歧
sections.timeline_note: 2011 首报阳性 → 2015 阴性 → 2017 分项阳性
sections.method_note: 均为随机对照试验，样本量 77-120

paragraphs.text: 两项试验报告益生菌优于安慰剂：单菌株试验见全局症状评分显著下降，多菌株试验见腹胀评分显著改善。
但 2015 年的对照试验未发现益生菌在整体缓解上优于安慰剂，阳性与阴性结果并存，疗效结论存在分歧。

sections.heading: 菌株特异性与机制边界
sections.timeline_note: 2020 年系统综述对前述分歧给出解释框架
sections.method_note: 系统综述（人群+机制证据）

paragraphs.text: 系统综述提示益生菌效应具有菌株与剂量依赖性，合并异质菌株可能掩盖菌株特异信号，这为上述分歧提供了可检验的解释。

evidence_table.quote: Patients receiving Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 showed a clinically meaningful reduction in global symptom scores compared with placebo (p=0.02)
Bloating scores decreased significantly in the probiotic group versus placebo (p=0.01)
Overall symptom relief did not differ between groups at week 10 (p=0.31)
Included trials suggest that effects are strain- and dose-dependent, and that pooling heterogeneous strains may mask strain-specific signals
Adverse events were similar between groups
Tolerability was good with no serious adverse events
